mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.crop_name, d.disease_name, d.en_name, d.create_time, c.symptom, c.cause, c.pesticide, c.farming FROM disease_info d LEFT JOIN disease_control c ON d.id = c.disease_id WHERE d.id = #{id}

SELECT di.id AS id, di.crop_name AS cropName, di.disease_name AS diseaseName, dc.symptom, dc.cause, dc.pesticide, dc.farming FROM disease_info di LEFT JOIN disease_control dc ON di.id = dc.disease_id WHERE di.id = #{diseaseId}

SELECT di.id AS id, di.crop_name AS cropName, di.disease_name AS diseaseName, dc.symptom, dc.cause, dc.pesticide, dc.farming FROM disease_info di LEFT JOIN disease_control dc ON di.id = dc.disease_id WHERE di.en_name = #{enName} LIMIT 1
